_doc: Rules for eagle_asset_notes.py. Copy next to your config.json (or point config 'assetNotesRules' at it) and edit. Only Eagle items in a folder whose path starts with folders[].prefix (plain string prefix: 'A/01 Characters' also matches 'A/01 Characters · Mascot') get a note. Keys starting with _ are ignored.

_docKeys.library: Library alias from config.json (or a .library path).
_docKeys.noteRoot: Vault folder for asset notes; notes go to {noteRoot}/{folders[].group}/{Eagle name}.md.
_docKeys.baseFile: Optional. Bases file linked from every note's Source section.
_docKeys.author: Optional. Value of the author property.
_docKeys.lang: 'en' (default) or 'ko' for the note body headings.
_docKeys.variantSuffixes: Names ending with these (e.g. an upscaled '-hd' copy) share the original's note.
_docKeys.systemTags: Type/system tags that are not copied into note tags and not used as titles or keywords.
_docKeys.genTagPrefixes: Tags starting with these are image-model IDs -> genModel property.
_docKeys.titleKeys: Annotation markers; the text after the first one found becomes the title (cut at ' · ', ' — ', newline).
_docKeys.titlePatterns: Optional regex fallbacks for the title: [{pattern, format}] where format uses {0} (whole match), {1}, {2}...
_docKeys.titleTagPattern: Optional regex; when no title key/pattern matches, only own tags matching it form the title.
_docKeys.characters: Tag names copied into the characters property when present.
_docKeys.extraFrontmatter: Constant properties added to every new note.
_docKeys.commandFields: Optional {property: [command, args...]}; the command's stdout becomes the value (omitted when empty or failing).
_docKeys.fieldOrder: Optional property order; properties not listed keep the default order after the listed ones.
_docKeys.folders: [{prefix, group, assetKind, usage, defaultScene?, category?, categoryFromTags?, defaultCategory?}]
_docKeys.scene: Decided in order: overrides -> kindScene (fixed per assetKind) -> sceneKeywords (first match against name, own tags and title; the full annotation is NOT searched because headers like 'Usage: lecture deck' cause misclassification) -> category value scene -> folders[].defaultScene -> defaultScene.
_docKeys.category: Optional second classification (e.g. owning team). Value decided in order: overrides[name].category -> folders[].categoryFromTags with category.fromTags -> folders[].category -> category.keywords -> folders[].defaultCategory -> category.default. category.values[value] = {frontmatter: {...}, scene: fallback scene, body: [lines; {scene} {name} {title} are filled]}.
